Alternative Version of get_veg_class_increment()

Source: R/veg_class_functions.R
get_veg_class_increment_2.Rd

Alternative Version of get_veg_class_increment()

Usage

get_veg_class_increment_2(
  tree_measure_volume,
  unsealed_area_m2,
  veg_class,
  max_vegetation_class = MAX_VEGETATION_CLASS,
  exponent = EXPONENT,
  source_max = SOURCE_MAX,
  target_max = TARGET_MAX
)

Arguments

tree_measure_volume

added green volume (m3)

unsealed_area_m2

unsealed area (m2)

veg_class

current vegetation class

max_vegetation_class

Default: 75

exponent

Default: 1.23

source_max

maximum veg_norm value. Default: 28.3 (found in Berlin data)

target_max

maximum veg_class value. Default: 55 (found in Berlin data, for non-forested areas)
